annotations.title: Create a draft item on a GitHub project

description: Create a draft item (a title and a body that live only on the board, with no repository, labels or milestone) on a project board the viewer may update, and set field values in the same call. github_project_item_convert turns a draft into an issue. With no Status given the draft starts as Todo when the board has a Status single select with that option. Once the draft exists, a field that fails to set does not fail the call: it is listed in errors as fields.<Field name>, and the item is still returned. Field values are set by field name and option or iteration name, matched without regard to case: text as a string, number as a number or numeric string, date as YYYY-MM-DD, single select as an option name, iteration as an iteration title or @current (the iteration containing today, UTC). Only text, number, date, single select and iteration fields can be set; a column that mirrors an issue field is set with the issue tools' issue_fields, not here. GitHub's own (Title, Assignees, Labels, Milestone, Repository, Linked pull requests, …) are set on the issue, and github_issue_edit sets assignees, labels and milestone. Every field and value is checked before anything is written. A board is named by project: its number, owner/number or its URL, used as it is; any other project is a title, and no project is Roadmap: the open board of that whole title is looked up, never guessed, in owner's boards if owner is given, else in the boards linked to repo, then its organization's, then the viewer's. Needs a token with the project scope; if GitHub reports missing scopes, run gh auth refresh -s project.

body.description: Markdown body; empty when left out.

fields.description: Field values to set, by field name: {"Status": "Todo", "Target": "2026-12-01"}. Values are text, a number, a YYYY-MM-DD date, an option name or an iteration title (@current is the one containing today). A column that mirrors an issue field is set with the issue tools' issue_fields, not here.

owner.description: A user or organization login, or "@me": the owner of a numbered board, else the only owner searched for a title.

project.description: The board, as its number, owner/number or its URL (used as it is; a bare number takes owner, else the owner of repo or of the working tree's repository), or as its title, looked up among open boards (whole title, case-insensitive). Default: the title Roadmap.

repo.description: owner/name; defaults to the working tree's repository (its origin). Where the board lookup starts, and the owner of a bare board number.

name: github_project_item_create

errors.description: Failed steps, keyed by step (fields.<Field name>, blocked_by, kind, labels, milestone); {} when none.

fields.description: The values that were set, by field name as the board spells it: an option or iteration by its name, a number as a number.

owner.description: The login of the user or organization that owns the board.
